mapper.select: SELECT id, title FROM topics ORDER BY position
SELECT l.id, l.topic_id, l.title, l.can_do, l.est_minutes, p.completed_at FROM lessons l LEFT JOIN lesson_progress p ON p.lesson_id = l.id AND p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.position

SELECT l.id, l.topic_id, l.title, l.can_do, l.est_minutes, NULL::timestamptz AS completed_at FROM lessons l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lesson_progress p WHERE p.lesson_id = l.id AND p.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY l.position LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, can_do, scenario, ai_persona, opening_line, est_minutes FROM lessons WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, english, translation, example FROM phrases WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY position
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson_progress (user_id, lesson_id, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{lessonId}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT l.can_do FROM lesson_progress p JOIN lessons l ON l.id = p.lesson_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.completed_at DESC
